answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy authenticates nodes via physical unclonable functions embedded in quartz resonators. When admitting a new vertex into the consensus graph, peers measure harmonic phase shifts governed by microscopic ridge geometry on each crystal. An attacker cannot virtualize identities without incurring discrete piezoelectric fabrication and packaging costs per device. However, thermal fluctuations alter resonant frequencies, causing false rejections of valid nodes.
